parent_objective: audit bounded measured intervention effects before candidate materialization or intervention repair
blocked_by: M1517 measured intervention smoke produced null/weak gaps that must be interpreted before any follow-up branch
supersedes: direct candidate materialization or training from M1517 intervention plumbing

public_gates: M1518 must audit M1517 intervention rows and pair summary
M1518 must classify the null/weak intervention result without weakening the self-ID standard
M1518 must decide whether to repair timing, retarget closer to boundary, compare finite-window/current-response controls, or close the subset
M1518 must not materialize candidates or export a training corpus
M1518 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or alter actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not materialize candidates during the audit
do not claim self-identification from null or sub-threshold intervention effects

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the first bounded measured interventions for the admitted T5 high-speed subset
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: intervention result audit only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1517 artifacts are missing or malformed
stop if the audit treats sub-threshold gaps as self-identification evidence
stop if the audit routes directly to candidate materialization or training
stop if the audit ignores current-frame substitution risk
fallback_plan: if the null result is due to late intervention timing, route to timing-amplified intervention design
if rows are too safe, route to tighter terminal-boundary retargeting
if current observation dominates, route to finite-window/current-response comparison
if the subset is not useful for history necessity, close the subset and synthesize the branch
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1517 produced complete bounded intervention artifacts with null/weak effects

admission_evidence: M1517 completed 28 bounded intervention rows for four T5 high-speed targets with zero replay failures and guardrails false
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up timing repair, retarget repair, finite-window comparison, subset-close, or branch synthesis manifest
next_stage_criteria: candidate materialization remains blocked or the subset is closed

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1518 audits a null/weak intervention result; current ego response and scene geometry may dominate the selected rows, so sub-threshold ablations cannot support level3 self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: audit normal vs reset/zero/delayed/wrong-donor margin gaps
separate intervention-plumbing success from history-necessity evidence
record null effects as task/intervention evidence rather than lowering the claim threshold
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1517 T5 high-speed intervention rows and 64-step continuations only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no outcome-relevant gap appears, record the null result and choose a repair, closure, or synthesis route instead of materializing weak candidates.
allowed_claims: M1518 audits M1517 measured intervention effects
no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1517 null/weak measured-intervention result can be audited to choose the next highest-leverage route without over-claiming self-identification.
success_criteria: audit summarizes M1517 row counts, margin gaps, success drops, and guardrails
audit classifies the result as candidate-materialization admissible, repair-needed, subset-closed, or branch-synthesis-needed
audit keeps candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes corpus export and self-ID claims blocked unless future measured evidence justifies a separate manifest
failure_criteria: audit treats null or sub-threshold gaps as self-identification evidence
audit starts candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout or corpus export
decision_rule: M1518 passes if it audits the M1517 null/weak intervention result and chooses a follow-up route without materializing candidates or claiming self-identification.
